description: Starts a real-time price quote for a California auto, home, condo, renters, or home and auto policy with Susman Insurance Agency. The details go to the agency's rating service and to the insurance companies it represents, the quote is saved at the agency, and a licensed agent may follow up. It is meant for a real person who has agreed to the consent wording. A driver's license number or Social Security number is not part of a quote, and a request that carries one is refused. The result is either the prices or a reference for reading them once pricing finishes, usually within a minute. Prices are estimates; nothing is bought or bound.

gender.description: Gender, as the rating service records it.

incidents.description: Accidents, violations and comprehensive losses of this driver in the past five years. Empty when there are none. Part of auto quotes.

items.description: One accident, violation or comprehensive loss in the past five years.

date.description: The month it happened. Format YYYY-MM.

lossType.description: For a comprehensive loss: what happened, for example theft, glass, weather or vandalism.

violationType.description: For a violation: the kind of violation.

occupation.description: Occupation, from the current list of occupations within that industry.

address.description: The home address, or where the vehicles are kept. California only.

agent.description: Optional: the assistant or product sending this.

name.description: Name of the assistant or product.

gender.description: Gender, as the rating service records it.

incidents.description: Accidents, violations and comprehensive losses of this driver in the past five years. Empty when there are none. Part of auto quotes.

items.description: One accident, violation or comprehensive loss in the past five years.

accidentType.description: For an accident: who was at fault and whether anyone was hurt.

date.description: The month it happened. Format YYYY-MM.

lossType.description: For a comprehensive loss: what happened, for example theft, glass, weather or vandalism.

industry.description: Employment industry, from the current list of industries.

occupation.description: Occupation, from the current list of occupations within that industry.

phone.description: US phone number of the person, 10 digits.

preferredContact.description: How the person prefers to be reached.

consent.description: The agreement of the person to the consent wording.

contactOk.description: True when the person has agreed that the agency may contact them about the quote by phone, text or email.

wordingVersion.description: The version of the consent wording the person agreed to.

coverage.description: The coverage asked for and the insurance the person has now.

collisionDeductible.description: Collision deductible, from the current list. Part of auto quotes.

comprehensiveDeductible.description: Comprehensive deductible, from the current list. Part of auto quotes.

contentsCoverage.description: Estimated value of the contents, the personal belongings in the home, in whole dollars. Part of condo and renters quotes.

currentAutoInsurer.description: Current auto insurance company as the current list names it, or Other, or None when the person has no auto insurance now. Part of auto quotes.

currentAutoPolicyExpiration.description: The day the current auto policy expires, YYYY-MM-DD, or the month as YYYY-MM. Goes with a current auto insurer other than None.

currentLiabilityLimits.description: Liability limits of the current auto policy, from the current list. Goes with a current auto insurer other than None.

dwellingCoverage.description: Estimated dwelling coverage in whole dollars. Part of home quotes.

homeDeductible.description: Home deductible, from the current list. Part of home, condo and renters quotes.

homeInsurerDifferentFromAuto.description: On a home and auto quote: whether the home insurer is a different company from the auto insurer.

policyStartDate.description: The day the new policy would start. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

home.description: The home to quote. Part of home, condo and renters quotes.

claims.description: Home insurance claims in the past five years. Empty when there are none.

date.description: The month of the claim. Format YYYY-MM.

electricalUpdateYear.description: Year the electrical system was substantially updated, when it was.

feetToCoast.description: Distance to the coast in feet, for a home less than a mile from it.

fireExtinguisher.description: Whether the home has a fire extinguisher.

heatingUpdateYear.description: Year the heating system was substantially updated, when it was.

milesToCoast.description: Distance to the coast in miles. The distance is given in miles, in feet, or both, and is above zero.

numberOfUnits.description: Number of units in the building. For a condo, co-op or apartment, and on every condo or renters quote.

plumbingUpdateYear.description: Year the plumbing was substantially updated, when it was.

residenceType.description: Residence type, from the current list.

roofUpdateYear.description: Year the roof was replaced or substantially updated, when it was.

smokeDetector.description: Whether the home has working smoke detectors.

smokersInHousehold.description: Whether anyone in the household smokes.

yearsAtResidence.description: Years the person has lived there. 0 for a new purchase or a recent move.

product.description: What is quoted: auto, home (homeowners insurance), home and auto together, condo (for a condo or co-op the person owns), or renters (for a home the person rents).

vehicles.description: The vehicles to quote, one to six. Part of auto quotes.

make.description: Make, as the current list of makes for that year spells it.

model.description: Model, as the current list of models for that make spells it.

primaryDriver.description: Who drives this vehicle most: 0 is the applicant, 1 the first additional driver, and so on. The applicant when left out.

styleId.description: The body style, as the id the current list of body styles gives it.

use.description: Primary use, from the current list of uses.

vin.description: The 17-character VIN, when the person has it. It is kept for the agency and is not used for pricing.
